scope: Proposition 6.2 (Linear variance lower bound) of the manuscript “Variance of the Random k-SAT Hitting Time” (preprints/Variance-of-the-Random-k-SAT-Hitting-Time-September-27-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 235 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e47a7c16a835f91), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Ln be positive integer caps of order O(n) and suppose Pn(Ln − 1) ≤ 1/4 for all sufficiently large n. Then Var(min{Hn, Ln}) ≥ ckn for all sufficiently large n, with ck > 0. In particular, for every fixed B > Uk and every fixed k ≥ 4, Var(Hn) = Θk(n), Var(Tn,B) = Θk,B(n), Var(min{Hn − 1, ⌊Bn⌋}) = Θk,B(n). (6.3) For k = 3, the corresponding variances lie between positive constant multiples of n and n log n.
